facts.fact: Libya Update, citing LANA, reports the Ministry of Civil Service launched a one-week, ten-hour computer-applications course for government employees in Benghazi on 14 September 2025, the first of a series on electronic archiving.
facts.system: Ministry of Civil Service computer applications course

LBY.note: Course was for government employees only.
A trainer who is a university faculty member is quoted; no research on digital policy stated.
